✔ local HTTP fixture observes two backend instances using fresh signed connections; not Kubernetes proof (61.2488ms)
✔ one observed instance fails minimum two; missing header also fails (16.1506ms)
✔ audit uses human credentials and investigation GET only (13.24ms)
✔ credential separation and unsafe origins refuse before network I/O (5.2372ms)
✔ timeout is ambiguous without retry; redirect and failed receipt stay failures (57.7203ms)
✔ opt-in readiness retains failed preflight then measures only after recovery (1024.9287ms)
✔ permanent preflight failure skips every measurement and preserves readiness failure (133.9009ms)
✔ both distribution Jobs opt into the same bounded readiness phase (0.7116ms)
▶ 실제 HTTP 경계 · 증거 · 거버넌스 · 복구 통합
  ✔ 원문/tenant/source 사칭, 임의 조회와 변조 HMAC 거부 (135.4953ms)
  ✔ 접수 COMMIT, replay/duplicate/ID conflict, tenant 격리 (40.0379ms)
  ✔ 자기보고/독립 결과, 자동검토/사람승인, 뒤늦은 권한 재평가 (111.5198ms)
  ✔ 안전한 룰 DSL·시험·두 사람 승인·예외 만료 (804.4437ms)
  ✔ 원본 참조 사건 담당·의견·종결 사유·tenant 접근 (19.3181ms)
  ✔ 빈 증거 통과 금지, 시스템 변경·기한 재검토, 보완과제 쓰기 (47.3162ms)
  ✔ 독립 신뢰키 검증·내용/누락/순서/키 대체 및 rollback 탐지 (65.2671ms)
  ✔ 다중 실제 writer·worker 동시성: 중복·체인 분기 없음 (327.0465ms)
  ✔ 강제 종료 이후 성공 접수 보존·조회 사본 재구축 (186.392ms)
  ✔ 실제 SQLite 쓰기 잠금 장애: 거짓 성공 없음·해제 뒤 재전송 (5491.604ms)
  ✔ 수집 실패가 업무 호출을 대기시키지 않는 유한 SDK (31.8018ms)
  ✔ 합성 예제 end-to-end 실제 API 시드·규정 요구 20개 (450.1365ms)
✔ 실제 HTTP 경계 · 증거 · 거버넌스 · 복구 통합 (8102.2067ms)
✔ synthetic two-node gateway topology is linked by service label and Pod UID without asserting autoscaling (2.4816ms)
✔ synthetic stale, terminating, wrong-service and wrong-UID endpoints cannot count as ready topology (1.4635ms)
✔ synthetic duplicate EndpointSlices and same-node replicas do not fabricate node diversity (0.2774ms)
✔ synthetic Pod UID matches do not validate unrelated or partly mismatched endpoint addresses (0.2611ms)
✔ synthetic unknown endpoint readiness still requires a live Ready Pod and correct service binding (0.1707ms)
✔ collector command contract is read-only and pins context and timeout on every command (0.5551ms)
✔ fake kubectl runner failures remain failures and neither stderr nor raw Pod env reaches the report (1.886ms)
✖ gateway readiness follows vault loss and recovery while local liveness stays available (350.6707ms)
✖ serving gateway identity is bounded and cannot be replaced by request or upstream headers (611.4542ms)
✔ readiness requests coalesce, cache briefly, validate the upstream result and time out (4021.9739ms)
✖ worker liveness is local but readiness requires a successful analysis tick (355.1295ms)
✔ shutdown cannot turn an in-flight dependency probe into a ready response (3528.2853ms)
✔ authority uses issuance time and policy known at execution, including late-arriving evidence (1.6927ms)
✔ human approval issued after execution or under another policy never satisfies prior review (0.3153ms)
✔ self-reported delegation cannot substitute for independent parent-scoped authority (0.2711ms)
✔ stop confirmation matches the requested target and follows the request (1.2907ms)
✖ 보존 정책·법적 hold·두 사람 승인·암호키 파기·독립 증명 (163.3947ms)
✔ 무단 키 누락·검색 사본 변조는 정당한 보존 종료로 위장할 수 없다 (678.5247ms)
✔ 승인 이후 추가된 보존 hold는 파기 실행 시 재확인된다 (1709.4314ms)
✔ 변경된 원장 head를 정상 조회가 재서명해 정당화하지 않는다 (570.2985ms)
▶ 실제 TLS 인증서·호스트 검증과 gateway → vault 신뢰 경계
  ✔ 신뢰하지 않은 CA는 클라이언트 TLS handshake 실패 (96.5565ms)
  ✔ NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS로 신뢰한 CA와 IP·DNS SAN은 성공 (215.8722ms)
  ✔ 신뢰한 CA도 SAN 불일치 서버는 거부 (101.7312ms)
✖ 실제 TLS 인증서·호스트 검증과 gateway → vault 신뢰 경계 (1215.4605ms)
✔ 서비스 결과의 성공·실패 혼재를 성공 하나로 축약하지 않는다 (3.0855ms)
✔ 참고 데이터 자기보고·서비스 참조·누락·비밀 비수집을 실제 HTTP에서 구분 (685.5938ms)
✔ 현재 목적지 정책을 과거 행동에 소급하지 않고 시점별 정책과 불확실성을 표시 (0.4008ms)
✖ 행동 조사함: 이벤트를 행동으로 묶고 미확인·혼합 결과·권한 경계를 유지 (375.1096ms)
✔ 사람 판단: 필수 사유·범위·반증과 같은 행동 근거만 연결하고 작성자 위조를 차단 (557.9123ms)
✖ 새 증거·분석 변경은 재검토, 오래된 화면의 판단은 409, 사건 보고서는 독립 검증 (267.2919ms)
✖ 보고서는 이벤트·사건·판단·평가의 변조된 조회 복사본을 서명하지 않는다 (385.861ms)
✖ 검토 기한 만료와 정당한 원문 파기는 과거 판단을 보존하며 재검토로 표시 (380.1869ms)
✔ worker leases distribute disjoint jobs and commit deterministic output once (82.3397ms)
✔ worker identity, evidence references and tenant/action override cannot be supplied by caller (52.1383ms)
✔ second vault connection observes durable leases and completed results (55.7278ms)
✔ late evidence invalidates old results and expired leases recover after worker restart (69.0601ms)
✔ query projection edits cannot alter worker source evidence or policy snapshot (56.0596ms)
✔ evaluation, checkpoint, action version and lease completion roll back atomically on persistence failure (56.3023ms)
✔ findings are bounded with explicit total coverage, never reported as full analysis (182.5695ms)
✔ oversized action quarantines explicitly and stays unanalyzed without looping duplicate evaluations (2228.2333ms)
✔ analysis snapshot streams original ledger without bundle arrays and preserves historical asset policies (113.4826ms)
✔ oversized individual ledger rows are quarantined before parsing while checkpoint completeness remains mandatory (57.8046ms)
✔ streaming snapshot distinguishes authorized erasure, missing keys and illegally retained erased keys (65.1253ms)
✔ encrypted records without the new action header remain readable through bounded streaming (58.7068ms)
✖ worker HTTP claim/complete runs computation in client and denies source and audit boundary access (317.3394ms)
